inclusion.I1: Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality to analyze whole brain
inclusion.I2: Sample- participants included at least 6 human, clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients

exclusion.E2: Study should not focus on Parkinson's disease

inclusion.I3: Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality
inclusion.I4: Sample- participants included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) or picks disease patients
inclusion.I5: Sample- At least 6 participants in the patient group, and if there is a healthy/control group, at least 6 particpants in the control group
inclusion.I6: Studies that reported at least one result of a between‐group contrast in a defined stochastic space (i.e., Montreal Neurological Institute [MNI] or Talairach) comparing bvFTD group to controls, where bvFTD group is not pooled with other patient groups in this result.
inclusion.I7: Whole-brain evidence- The paper must report at least one group-level, whole-brain (voxelwise) result that is clearly identified as coming from the target sample group.
inclusion.I8: Coordinates must exist- the paper must report actual PEAK COORDINATES (x, y, z values in MNI or Talairach space) for at least one whole-brain bvFTD-versus-control contrast. Those coordinates may live in a main-text table, a supplementary table, or a figure caption, and it is acceptable that they are referenced rather than reproduced in the body text. A thresholded statistical map, a t-map, or a rendered figure WITHOUT any accompanying peak coordinates does not satisfy this criterion.

exclusion.E6: Studies whose qualifying result comes from a region-of-interest analysis- this includes voxelwise analyses confined to an anatomical MASK, small-volume-corrected (SVC) results, and analyses that only report per-region averages from a predefined atlas parcellation. Exclude when no unrestricted whole-brain voxelwise result is also reported.
exclusion.E7: Sample- the bvFTD patient group is predominantly some other diagnosis (e.g. a group that is mainly Alzheimer's disease, another dementia, or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis without a behavioural-variant FTD syndrome), or the bvFTD cases are not separable from a concurrent psychiatric diagnosis or a history of alcohol or substance abuse in the reported contrast. Do NOT exclude on comorbidity alone- a bvFTD cohort in which some patients also have motor neuron disease, or a genetic/familial bvFTD cohort, still qualifies provided the reported contrast is that bvFTD group against controls.
exclusion.E8: Non-empirical papers (e.g., reviews, meta-analyses, methods-only, simulations) without original data.
exclusion.E9: only reports seed‐based functional connectivity (FC), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), or cortical thickness methods

inclusion.GLOBAL_I1: Whole-brain evidence- The analysis must be from a whole-brain (voxelwise) map
inclusion.GLOBAL_I2: Sample- analysis includes clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) or picks disease patients
inclusion.GLOBAL_I3: Analysis must compare the target bvFTD group to healthy controls

exclusion.GLOBAL_E2: Seed‐based functional connectivity (FC), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), and cortical thickness methods
exclusion.GLOBAL_E3: Explicit evidence of pooling bvFTD group with other patient groups in the analysis (e.g. bvFTD + other dementia group vs controls)

inclusion.DEMENTIA_ALL_I1: Uses Voxel-Based Morphometry, fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality

inclusion.DEMENTIA_DECREASING_ACTIVITY_I1: Analyses reporting any decreases in activity/connectivity, metabolism, or gray matter volume for bvFTD group (e.g. Control > bvFTD or bvFTD < Control)
inclusion.DEMENTIA_DECREASING_ACTIVITY_I2: Uses Voxel-Based Morphometry, fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality

inclusion.STRUCTURAL_I1: Uses Voxel-based morphometry (VBM) as the imaging modality

inclusion.FUNCTIONAL_I1: Uses fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality
